title.zh: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics

current_state.zh: Axiom Math's AI agents formally verified the Stacks Project, a massive algebraic geometry library, as part of its push to use machine-checked verification to filter unreliable AI-generated proofs out of mathematics.
